propositions: The close path exempts disposition-closed bugs (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) from completion-verifier attestation, but the certification path requires it on all closed children regardless, creating an uncertifiable state.

A disposition-closed child with a live replacement link cannot earn the required completion-verifier attestation through any non-force workflow—reopening and reclosing repeats the same exemption, creating a deadlock.

Two code paths implement conflicting rules for disposition handling: transition_close.py grants exemption at lines 253-260, but llm/completion.py:170-199 (child_closure_findings) enforces verification uniformly without a disposition branch.

A disposition close with a valid replacement link should mint a signed completion-verifier attestation recording the disposition class and replacement ID (not falsely claiming PASS), allowing certification to forward through the replacement.
